quint.scope: One packed header tuple, eight roles and three finite generations; decomposed read/CAS, spent/live bits, close, stale release and repeated helper handoff. Unique actors/roles, last-use release and VM storage lifetime are external premises. No weak-memory/native/liveness proof

lean.scope: Selective closure, spent role, idempotence, current tag, coverage and generation laws; not full QNT/C induction, encoding injectivity or Gambit activation source proof

runtimeImplementationScope: Only inactive native_scope primitive and VM initialization; whole architecture not adopted
